territorial_scope.description: Governs administrative sanctions imposed by Brazil's ANPD for infractions of the LGPD and ANPD regulations.

evidence.quote: aplicação de sanções administrativas pela Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados (ANPD)

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Brazil's data protection authority (ANPD) approves a regulation setting the methodology for calculating administrative sanctions under the LGPD, including infraction classes, aggravating and mitigating factors, and fine caps. It also amends the ANPD's sanctioning procedure rules and takes effect on publication.
summary.long: Resolution CD/ANPD No. 4 of 24 February 2023 approves the Regulation on Dosimetry and Application of Administrative Sanctions of Brazil's National Data Protection Authority (ANPD), which applies to infractions of the LGPD and ANPD regulations. Infractions are classified as light, medium or serious (Art. 8). Sanctions include warning, simple fine, daily fine, publicization, blocking, deletion, suspension of a database or processing activity, and prohibition of data-processing activities (Art. 3). The base value of a simple fine follows a methodology in Appendix I using the infringer's revenue, the infraction class and the degree of damage (Art. 11). Aggravating circumstances add up to 40%, 20%, 80% and 90%, and mitigating circumstances reduce the amount (Arts. 12-14). The result is subject to minimum values in Appendix II and capped at 2% of Brazilian revenue or R$ 50,000,000 (Art. 15). Daily fines accrue up to R$ 50,000,000 per infraction (Art. 16). Database or processing suspensions last at most six months, extendable once (Arts. 24-25). Payment is due within 20 business days, with a 25% reduction for waiving appeal (Arts. 17-18). The resolution also amends the ANPD's enforcement procedure rules (Art. 2), applies to ongoing proceedings (Art. 28) and takes effect on publication (Art. 4 of the resolution). The appendices are referenced but not reproduced in the fetched text.

enforcement.triggered_by: Infração to which the personal data relate (Art. 3, V; Art. 22)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: No monetary amount; temporary suspension of any processing operation of the personal data concerned, by keeping the data, until the infractor regularises the conduct (Art. 22, § 1º)
enforcement.cure_period: Blocking lasts until the infractor regularises the conduct; unblocking requires proof of regularisation (Art. 22, § 1º and § 3º)

evidence.quote: A ANPD poderá aplicar ao infrator a sanção de bloqueio dos dados pessoais.

enforcement.authority: Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados (ANPD)
enforcement.triggered_by: Infração to which the personal data relate (Art. 3, VI; Art. 23)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: No monetary amount; deletion (exclusão) of the personal data or data set concerned, regardless of the procedure used (Art. 23, § 1º)

evidence.quote: A ANPD poderá aplicar ao infrator a sanção de eliminação dos dados pessoais a que se refere a infração.

enforcement.authority: Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados (ANPD)
enforcement.triggered_by: Infração to which the database relates; may be applied only after at least one of the sanctions in Art. 3, II to VI has been imposed for the same case (Art. 3, VII and § 1º; Art. 24)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Partial suspension of the database operation for a maximum of 6 (seis) meses, extendable for an equal period, until the controller regularises the processing (Art. 24, § 2º)
enforcement.penalty_formula: Not applicable (duration-based sanction); duration considers public interest, impact on data subjects, infraction classification and complexity of regularisation (Art. 24, § 3º)
enforcement.cure_period: Suspension lasts until regularisation of the processing, proven by the infractor (Art. 24, § 2º and § 4º)

evidence.quote: será aplicada pelo período máximo de 6 (seis) meses, prorrogável por igual período

enforcement.authority: Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados (ANPD)
enforcement.triggered_by: Infração to which the processing relates; may be applied only after at least one of the sanctions in Art. 3, II to VI has been imposed for the same case (Art. 3, VIII and § 1º; Art. 25)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Suspension of the processing activity for a maximum of 6 (seis) meses, extendable for an equal period (Art. 25, § 1º)
enforcement.penalty_formula: Not applicable (duration-based sanction); duration considers public interest, impact on data subjects and infraction classification (Art. 25, § 2º)

evidence.quote: será aplicada pelo período máximo de 6 (seis) meses, prorrogável por igual período.

enforcement.authority: Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados (ANPD)
enforcement.triggered_by: Prohibition applies where there is recidivism after a suspension sanction, processing for illicit purposes or without a legal basis, or loss or non-compliance with technical and operational conditions (Art. 26, I to III); may be applied only after at least one of the sanctions in Art. 3, II to VI (Art. 3, IX and § 1º)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Partial or total prohibition of the exercise of activities related to personal data processing; no duration stated in this text (Art. 26)
